units.source_text: 他是个难以琢磨的人，这是我的第一感觉。

en.t: My first impression was that he was a man difficult to understand.

units.source_text: 他为什么突然向我说出这种事？

en.t: Why had he suddenly told me something like this?

units.source_text: 还有，他的恋情怎么会突然炽热到了非表白不可的程度？

en.t: And how had his love suddenly grown so intense that he had to confess it?

units.source_text: 平时的他又跑到哪儿去了呢？

en.t: Where had the usual him gone?

units.source_text: 这一切都令我无法理解。

en.t: All of this was beyond my understanding.

units.source_text: 我知道他很倔强，也知道他是个很认真的人。

en.t: I knew that he was stubborn, and I also knew that he was a very serious man.

units.source_text: 我相信在我决定自己以后应采取的态度之前，应该有很多话要向他问清楚。

en.t: I believed there were many things I needed to ask him clearly before deciding what attitude I should take from then on.

units.source_text: 同时，我一想到今后要与他成为情敌，便不寒而栗。

en.t: At the same time, the thought that I would become his rival in love from then on made me shudder.

units.source_text: 我心事重重地在街头乱走着，眼前总是浮现出静坐在自己房间中的K的面影，

en.t: As I wandered through the streets, weighed down by worry, the image of K sitting silently in his own room kept appearing before my eyes,

units.source_text: 耳边仿佛总是听到一个声音：不管你怎样走，也是撼动不了他的。

en.t: and it seemed that a voice was always sounding in my ears: no matter how far you walk, you cannot move him.

units.source_text: 这意思是说，对我而言，他就像是个魔鬼。

en.t: What that meant was that, to me, he was like a demon.

units.source_text: 我甚至忽然感觉，自己莫非已经被他施了魔咒，永无脱身之日了吧。

en.t: I even suddenly felt that perhaps he had already cast a spell on me, and that I would never be free of it.

units.source_text: 我疲惫不堪地回到家里的时候，K的房间依然静得犹如无人一般。

en.t: When I returned home utterly exhausted, K's room was still as quiet as if no one were there.
